Problem Statement:
You are given an array containing N integers: each integer is either 0 or 1.

You can "flip a range"
I.e make all the 0's ->1's and all the 1's->0s in a subarray [L,R] . You also want to know what is the sum of a subarray which is nothing but the number of 1s present in a subarray
These two operations are interweaved ( may occur in any order multiple number of times)
For example:  for an array of size 10 (1-based indexing) the sequence of operations might be:
Flip bits in range [1,3]
Find sum of range [2,7]
Flip bits in range[1,2]
And so on.
There are Q such operations

Perform the operations and report the answer successfully
input_spec:
The first line contains an integer N : the number of elements in the array
The next line contains N integers - each of which is either 0 or 1 : describing the contents of the array
The next line contains a single integer Q denoting the number of operations
The next Q line can be either of the following format:
1 x y : flip all bits from xth element of array to yth element of array
2 x y : report the sum for the subarray [x,y]
output_spec: For every type two operation output the subarray sum on a single line
